meta.title: Lingo - Free AI Game Chat Translator
meta.description: Lingo helps you translate the message you are about to send in game chat. Use a hotkey on Windows or macOS to turn short callouts into clear Chinese, English, or Russian.
meta.keywords: free game chat translator, AI game translator, game chat translation, gaming hotkey translator, multiplayer chat translator, Dota 2 translator, League of Legends translator, World of Warcraft translator, Overwatch 2 translator

hero.title: Game Chat Translator
hero.subtitle: Type the callout you want to send, hit the hotkey, and get a clearer Chinese, English, or Russian message without leaving the match.
hero.supportLine: Built for multiplayer games where text chat matters.

mockup.title: Translate, paste, keep playing
mockup.body: Turns retreat, group, smoke, and cooldown calls into natural chat-ready messages.
mockup.source: Don't force yet. Wait for my BKB.
mockup.result: Hold. Wait for my BKB, then we fight.

phrases.title: Sharper short lines

languages.title: Chinese, English, Russian

supportedGames.title: Built for multiplayer games with text chat.
